findings: Server recipe-grid update assembles and publishes a result preview. A nonempty preview is not payment or accepted player output.

ResultSlot.checkTakeAchievements sends the Forge crafting event before onTake obtains remaining items and walks the ingredient removal/remainder loop. This notification alone is not a post-debit receipt.

Quick-move attempts inventory transfer before onQuickCraft/onTake. A failed move returns EMPTY before those calls. Normal and quick-move notifications/stack counts must not be treated as identical debit acknowledgements.

ResultSlot removes one from each occupied ingredient slot, then handles crafting remainder placement/merge/inventory/drop. Ordinary flow still performs payment; event ordering is not a reproduced unpaid exploit.
ShapelessRecipe.assemble returns a copy of the configured result. Its serializer delegates to ShapedRecipe.itemStackFromJson, which delegates to Forge CraftingHelper with NBT enabled.

CraftingHelper accepts JSON-object or SNBT NBT, moves ForgeCaps into the enclosing stack data and builds ItemStack.of. It does not automatically preserve arbitrary input stack tags. Base item identity cannot replace the configured functional variant.

Installed FTB handler registers Architectury CRAFT_ITEM; its crafting method checks ServerPlayer and nonempty result then calls detect with that result. The Container argument is unused, and this method validates neither recipe ID nor material debit.
